purpose: Retrospective calibration of a process model, not prediction and not actor evaluation.
normalization: All resources are 0..1 operational encodings of ordinal relations in the source record. They are not scores of merit, competence, or electability.

Merz.basis: CDU chair, CDU/CSU parliamentary leader, May 2024 re-election, organizational default; no automatic legal nomination right.

Wuest.basis: NRW minister-president and chair of largest CDU Landesverband; plausible alternative but no federal party/fraktion office; younger future option.

Soeder.basis: CSU chair and Bavarian minister-president with strong CSU apparatus and visibility; candidacy path institutionally depends on a substantial call from the larger CDU.

organizational_nodes.NRW_CDU: Initially follows Wuest as Landeschef; can be reallocated by his endogenous decision.
organizational_nodes.Bundestagsfraktion: Baseline aligned with its chair Merz; alignment and strength are explicit sensitivity levers.
organizational_nodes.CSU_apparatus: Initially aligned with CSU chair Soeder; joint closure does not erase separate CSU identity.
organizational_nodes.Frei: Thin rule: organization and personal+institutional loyalty stabilize a legible fraktion signal.
organizational_nodes.Linnemann: Thin rule: implementation/Wirksamkeit converts sufficiently clear leadership into party organization.
organizational_nodes.Rhein: Thin role rule only; no full personality model claimed.
organizational_nodes.Hagel: Thin role rule including the publicly stated first-access norm; no full personality model claimed.
organizational_nodes.Guenther: Mehrheiten/consensus/operative responsibility; reacts after viable closure rather than creating the candidate ex nihilo.

personality_rules.Wuest: Ambition × Kontrolle × Akzeptanz × Timing is implemented as a weighted geometric mean so one weak conjunct can block a public irreversible challenge.
personality_rules.Merz: Agency/Gestaltung supplies the pull toward candidacy; risk capacity rises conditionally with backing and default resources; default reduces the value of premature public declaration.
personality_rules.Soeder: No rich psychological rule. Only source-supported strategic constraints: CSU apparatus, visibility, conditional availability, need for a CDU call, and declared preference for an agreed solution/no 2021 repeat.
personality_rules.Frei: Gestaltung through Organisation plus personal and institutional loyalty.
personality_rules.Linnemann: Wirksamkeit/implementation: organize once a workable direction is sufficiently clear.
personality_rules.Guenther: Mehrheiten/consensus/operative responsibility: endorse a viable joint closure and reduce organizational disorder.

unknown_black_boxes: The exact content and sequencing of Merz-Wuest private conversations.
Any succession promise, office promise, or quid pro quo; none is assumed.
The exact Merz-Soeder bilateral bargain and emotional state of either actor.
Latent preferences of individual CDU delegates and MPs not publicly expressed.
Counterfactual media shocks, polling changes, leaks, or third-party interventions.
Whether Wuest's public timing was coordinated in detail; content coordination and timing control remain separate questions.

allowed: bounded perception error about current resource states
randomness.interpretation: Monte Carlo shares are model-path frequencies under perturbation, never real-world probabilities.
